intro.title: One address. Two reasons to choose it.
intro.text: Most mountain holidays make you choose: a good place to sleep or a good place to eat. Here you don't have to. Go up to your apartment, come down for dinner. Same people, same standard, from check-in to the last pizza.

stay.title: Six apartments. Zero compromises.
stay.text: Every apartment is independent, with a fully equipped kitchen, living area and private bathroom. Real space for couples, families and groups of friends, with the freedom of a home and a restaurant right downstairs.

dine.title: Real Trentino cooking. Master-made pizza.
dine.text: Lunch and dinner built on the traditional recipes of Val di Sole and ingredients from our valleys. In the evening, pizza by our master pizzaiolo. Open to everyone, not just our guests.

exp.title: Val di Sole, right outside the door.
exp.text: In winter, ski Folgarida-Marilleva and Madonna di Campiglio. In summer, the cycle path, rafting on the Noce and the trails of two nature parks. You plan the day, we take care of the evening.

where.title: In the heart of Val di Sole.
where.text: We are in Dimaro Folgarida, minutes from the Folgarida-Marilleva lifts and right on the Val di Sole cycle path. Madonna di Campiglio and the Tonale Pass are within easy reach.

final.title: The best dates go first.
final.text: Send us your dates and we'll reply with availability and price. The request is not binding.

hero.title: Real Trentino cooking. Master-made pizza. No shortcuts.
hero.lead: The modern osteria of Val di Sole: ingredients from our valleys, traditional local recipes and a pizza worth the trip. Open to everyone, for lunch and dinner.

manifesto.title: If we wouldn't serve it to our own family, it doesn't reach your table.
manifesto.text: A restaurant isn't judged by its furniture. It's judged by the plate. That's why we start with the produce: mountain ingredients that are seasonal and traceable, chosen from producers in our valleys. Then we treat them with respect, using the traditional recipes of Val di Sole and Trentino and today's technique.

pillars.title: Roots
pillars.text: The recipes we grew up with, from the traditions of Val di Sole and Trentino. Every dish starts there.

pillars.title: Season
pillars.text: The menu follows the mountain. We use what the valleys give at that moment, at its best.

pillars.title: Craft
pillars.text: Modern technique in service of flavour, not effect. Nothing superfluous on the plate.

kitchen.title: Tradition, done today.
kitchen.text: Trentino dishes reinterpreted with a modern touch, plus a few international options for those who want to leave the beaten path. Fresh ingredients, honest portions, clear flavours. The lunch you need between runs and the dinner you remember at the end of your holiday.
kitchen.menu: The full menu will soon be available on this page.

pizza.title: Pizza is a craft. Our master knows it.
pizza.text: Every pizza comes from the hands of our master pizzaiolo. Carefully made dough, quality seasonal toppings, considered pairings. You'll find the classics you love and special combinations born in our kitchen that you won't find anywhere else.

services.title: The same standard, wherever you want to eat.

items.title: Takeaway and home delivery
items.text: Our cooking and our pizza, at your home or in your holiday apartment. Same care, same taste.

items.title: Garden and events
items.text: Summer evenings outdoors, birthdays, group dinners and parties. The garden is ready for your event.

items.title: Business lunches and meetings
items.text: A private room, presentation equipment, coffee breaks, buffet or light lunch. You focus on the meeting, we handle the rest.

restaurant.quote: The valleys provide the ingredients. We bring the craft.

book.title: Your table is waiting.
book.text: Soon you'll be able to book online with TheFork or message us on WhatsApp. In the meantime, we look forward to welcoming you at Via Campiglio 59.

meta.title: Things to do in Val di Sole, winter and summer | Locanda dei Gemelli
meta.description: Skiing in Folgarida-Marilleva, Madonna di Campiglio, Passo Tonale and Pejo, cross-country, snowshoeing, thermal spa and Christmas markets, plus summer in the valley. All a few minutes from Locanda dei Gemelli in Dimaro.

hero.title: Two seasons. A valley that never stops.
hero.lead: Dimaro Folgarida is the ideal starting point: slopes in winter, rivers and trails in summer. You choose the day, we take care of the evening.

winter.title: Snow just minutes from the door.
winter.lead: Dimaro Folgarida sits at the heart of one of the largest ski areas in Trentino. The lifts are a handful of minutes away, Madonna di Campiglio can be reached on skis, and the glaciers of Tonale and Pejo are less than an hour's drive.
winter.photoAlt: Snowy piste with a chairlift among the larches, below the peaks

ski.title: Four ski areas, one base.
ski.note: Approximate driving times from the Locanda. Ski area figures refer to the current season and may vary with lift openings.

items.title: Folgarida-Marilleva
items.text: Our home ski area. The Folgarida gondolas start a few minutes from the Locanda and climb to runs carved through the forest, with two floodlit slopes for skiing after sunset. From Daolasa the gondola reaches 2,000 metres in twelve minutes.

items.title: Madonna di Campiglio
items.text: Linked on skis with Folgarida-Marilleva and Pinzolo: together they form the Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta. Slopes up to 2,500 metres facing the UNESCO-listed Brenta Dolomites, and long descents such as the Graffer, almost five kilometres. By car, you simply follow the same road the Locanda is on.
facts: over 150 km with Folgarida and Pinzolo

items.title: Passo del Tonale and Presena Glacier
items.text: The Pontedilegno-Tonale ski area joins Trentino and Lombardy. The Presena glacier takes you up to 3,000 metres, with reliable snow all season long and skiing well into spring. At 2,000 metres, a snowpark with a skicross course.

items.title: Pejo3000
items.text: A quieter, more intimate ski area inside the Stelvio National Park. Less crowded slopes, a ski school that looks after children, and a cable car rising towards 3,000 metres. It presents itself as the world's first plastic-free ski area.

tips.title: One ski pass, eight resorts.
tips.text: The Skirama Dolomiti Adamello Brenta ski pass opens up 380 km of slopes and 150 lifts: besides the Val di Sole ski areas it includes Paganella, Monte Bondone and Alpe Cimbra. A full week without skiing the same run twice.

tips.title: By train to the lifts.
tips.text: The Trento–Malè–Mezzana railway stops in Dimaro and in Daolasa, where the station connects directly to the gondola up to the slopes. Leave the car parked and reach the mountain with your skis on your shoulder.

map.title: The whole ski area at a glance.
map.text: Folgarida-Marilleva, Madonna di Campiglio and Pinzolo are linked on skis. Explore the map: tap a point to discover altitudes, huts and services.
map.alt: Piste map of the Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta, from Folgarida and Marilleva to Madonna di Campiglio and Pinzolo
map.caption: Interactive map: tap the points to discover villages, peaks and huts. Map © Cormar, Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta.

beyond.title: The valley in winter, even without skis.

items.title: Cross-country skiing
items.text: Around 45 km of Nordic trails across Passo Tonale, Vermiglio, Cogolo, Ossana, Mezzana, Commezzadura and Rabbi, with two equipped cross-country centres in Vermiglio and Val di Rabbi. The Commezzadura trail is the closest to the Locanda.

items.title: Snowshoeing
items.text: Dozens of marked routes through forests, old farmsteads and mountain huts, from easy to demanding. Two start right in Dimaro Folgarida: the climb to Malghet Aut and the Via degli Imperatori. Snowshoes can be rented in the village.

items.title: Ski touring and freeride
items.text: Ascents to Malga Saviana, Monte Sole in Val di Rabbi or the Presena Glacier, best tackled with the guides of the Val di Sole mountaineering and ski touring school. Always carry a transceiver, shovel and probe.

items.title: Pejo thermal spa
items.text: After the snow, the warmth. In Peio Fonti, the waters of the valley's three historic springs, a pool and a wellness area, open in winter too. The best way to loosen tired legs at the end of the day.

items.title: Christmas markets and nativity scenes
items.text: At Christmas, Ossana becomes the village of nativity scenes, with more than a thousand cribs along its lanes and courtyards beneath San Michele castle. Val di Rabbi answers with its Valley of Nativity Scenes, while Malè and Val di Pejo light up their Christmas stalls.

items.title: Snow experiences
items.text: Husky sledding at Passo del Tonale, fat biking on snowy trails, ice climbing on frozen waterfalls and the Fevri toboggan run in Madonna di Campiglio, almost three kilometres of descent.

photos.credit: Winter photo: Giorgio Galeotti, Malghet Aut (Folgarida), Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0

items.title: Val di Sole cycle path
items.text: The cycle path runs through Dimaro and follows the Noce river along the valley. Perfect for families, e-bikes included.

items.title: Rafting on the Noce
items.text: The Noce is one of Europe's best-loved rivers for rafting and kayaking, with routes for beginners and experts.

items.title: Hiking in the parks
items.text: Stelvio National Park and Adamello Brenta Nature Park: trails, mountain huts and alpine lakes for every level.

base.title: The day is yours. The evening is ours.
base.text: Back from the slopes or the trail, go up to your apartment and come down for dinner. No car to take, no table to hunt for.

meta.description: How we handle the personal data of visitors to the Locanda dei Gemelli website and of guests who send us a booking request.

privacy.title: Privacy and cookies
privacy.lead: How we handle your data when you visit this website or send us a request (Art. 13 of EU Regulation 2016/679, GDPR).

p: {company}, registered office {address}, tax code and VAT no. {vat}. For any privacy question write to {email} or to the certified email (PEC) {pec}.
Data you send us with the request form: first name, last name, email, phone, dates of stay, number of guests and children's ages, pets, preferred apartment and any message.
Technical browsing data: the website host (GitHub Pages) automatically logs IP address, browser and pages visited, for security and operation.

sections.h: Why we use it and on what legal basis
p: To reply to your request and, if you wish, arrange your stay: a pre-contractual step taken at your request (Art. 6.1.b GDPR). Without this data we cannot reply.
To meet legal obligations if the stay is confirmed, such as tax rules and the registration of guests with the police authorities (Art. 6.1.c GDPR).
We do not use your data for advertising and we never sell it.

FormSubmit (formsubmit.co), the service that forwards the form to our mailbox; Google (Gmail), which runs the mailbox; GitHub (Microsoft), which hosts the website. They process data on our behalf. Some are based in the United States: transfers take place with the safeguards required by the GDPR (EU-US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses).
We do not share data with anyone else unless required by law.
Requests that do not turn into a booking: up to 24 months, then deleted. Data of a confirmed stay: for the period required by law (for example 10 years for tax records).
This website does not use its own cookies, profiling cookies or analytics tools.
Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts: to do so, your browser shares your IP address with Google.
The Google Maps map loads only if you click "Show the map": from then on Google may set its own cookies. Links to Google Maps open Google's website, under its own privacy policy.

You can ask us at any time to access, correct or delete your data, restrict or object to its processing, or receive it in a portable format (Arts. 15-22 GDPR), by writing to {email} or to the PEC {pec}.
If you believe your data is not handled correctly you can lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (www.garanteprivacy.it) or the authority of your country.
